title: Pack reason catalogue entry
description: One pack reason code (DEC-2026-10-16 money-and-value-lists §2.3). The code is <vertical>.reason.<name>, so it can never equal an upper-case core code. packcheck also rejects a code outside the pack's own namespace.

produced_by.description: Where the code is produced: a policy rule (T11) or the pack mappings for T10 or T12.
